Effective Date: December 29, 2025

JOTS.MEDIA ("JOTS.MEDIA," "we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting privacy and handling data responsibly. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard information when you visit https://jots.media or engage with our services.

By accessing our website or using our services, you acknowledge and agree to this Privacy Policy.

1. Information We Collect

1.1 Information You Provide

We collect information you voluntarily provide when you:

  • Contact us or submit inquiries

  • Enter into service agreements
  • Upload files, media, or creative assets
  • Subscribe to communications

This information may include:

  • Name

  • Company or brand name

1.2 Information Collected Automatically

When you visit our website, we may automatically collect:

  • IP address
  • Browser and device type
  • Operating system

  • Referring URLs

This data is used for analytics, performance monitoring, and security.

2. How We Use Information

We process information for the following purposes:

  • Delivering and managing services
  • Communicating regarding projects or inquiries
  • Improving site functionality and offerings
  • Business operations, analytics, and security
  • Marketing communications (where consent is provided)
  • Legal and regulatory compliance

JOTS.MEDIA does not sell personal data.

3. AI-Specific Data Use & Disclosure

JOTS.MEDIA provides AI-enabled services, including AI implementation, automation, content generation, analysis, and optimization.

3.1 Use of AI Tools
  • We may use third-party or proprietary AI tools to support client projects.
  • AI systems may process text, images, audio, video, code, or structured data provided by clients solely for project execution.
3.2 Client Data & AI Training
  • Client data is not used to train public or general-purpose AI models unless explicitly agreed to in writing.
  • Any AI training, fine-tuning, or dataset reuse requires prior client authorization.
3.3 AI Output Limitations
  • AI-generated outputs may be probabilistic, incomplete, or inaccurate.
  • Clients remain responsible for reviewing, validating, and approving AI-assisted deliverables before use.
  • JOTS.MEDIA does not guarantee AI outputs will be error-free, compliant, or fit for a specific regulatory purpose.

4. Creative Services & Confidentiality

JOTS.MEDIA provides multimedia and technical services including:

  • Web and graphic design
  • AI implementation
  • Social media services
  • Merchandise design
  • Audio and video production
  • App development
  • Photography

All client materials and project communications are treated as confidential and used exclusively to perform contracted services, unless otherwise authorized in writing.

5. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

We use cookies and similar technologies for analytics, performance optimization, and security. You may adjust cookie settings in your browser. Disabling cookies may affect site functionality.

6. Third-Party Service Providers

We may share limited data with vetted third-party providers (e.g., hosting, analytics, cloud infrastructure, payment processors, AI platforms) strictly as required to perform services. All providers are obligated to protect data under applicable agreements.

7. Data Security

We implement reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards to protect personal information. No system can guarantee absolute security, but we actively monitor and mitigate risk.

8. Your Privacy Rights

8.1 GDPR (EU / UK Residents)

You have the right to:

  • Access personal data
  • Rectify inaccuracies
  • Request erasure
  • Restrict or object to processing
  • Data portability
  • Withdraw consent at any time
8.2 CCPA / CPRA (California Residents)

You have the right to:

  • Know what personal data is collected
  • Access your data
  • Request deletion
  • Opt out of the sale or sharing of personal data (we do not sell data)
  • Non-discrimination for exercising rights

Requests may be submitted to: hello@jots.media

9. Children's Privacy

JOTS.MEDIA does not knowingly collect data from children under 13. Any such data identified will be promptly deleted.

10. Policy Updates

This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically. Continued use of the site constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
